question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.country_id,
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END as points
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.country_id,
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 0
            WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END as points
    FROM Match m
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) as total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY country_id, league_id, season, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_id, league_id, season ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT 
    t.team_long_name as team_name,
    l.name as league,
    c.name as country,
    rp.total_points as total_points
FROM ranked_teams rp
JOIN Team t ON rp.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON rp.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON rp.country_id = c.id
WHERE rp.rn = 1
ORDER BY c.name, l.name, rp.season

            ELSE 1
        END as points
    FROM Match m
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) as total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY country_id, league_id, season, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_id, league_id, season ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM team_points
)

    c.name as country,

JOIN League l ON rp.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON rp.country_id = c.id
WHERE rp.rn = 1
ORDER BY c.name, l.name, rp.season
